definition: furniture with a flat top and legs
description: A group of friends sit around a long wooden dining table by a bright window, covered with dishes: a whole roast chicken, a pizza in its box, bowls of salad, pasta and fries, a round loaf of bread and glasses of beer. They pass plates of grilled vegetables across the table to each other, one woman holds out a slice of pizza, hands tear pieces off the loaf, and the camera pulls back to show the whole laden table with everyone smiling and reaching over it.
